subject: Mobile Development
title: Phone Bans in Schools
description: One-minute skill: Phone Bans in Schools.

hook.text: France banned smartphones in schools in 2018. Dozens of countries have followed.

buildup.text: Teachers report that students can't focus when phones buzz every few minutes.

discovery.text: Studies show test scores improve in schools that ban phones during class time.

twist.text: Parents argue phones are essential for safety — they need to reach their children.

climax.text: The school phone debate reflects a larger question: where should phones not go?

quiz.question: Which country was among the first to ban phones in schools?
